summary:
Revised Part B implementation plan incorporating all 7 corrections:
1. Real Room migration test setup with exportSchema = true, KSP room.schemaLocation configured to app/schemas, generating 2.json before entity changes and 3.json after, tested with MigrationTestHelper.
2. updateTransactionsCategoryName kept intentionally unfiltered so renamed categories update trashed rows too.
3. Complete 15-query existing + 8-query new DAO audit table where every query touching transactions is marked Filtered, Intentionally Unfiltered, or Trash-Only, keeping deleteTransactionById and clearAllTransactions unfiltered.
4. Removed the extra Data Check card (Part A Data Check screen does not exist in the repo yet, so it will be skipped and noted).
5. Updated MonthEndMath.kt to multiply before dividing ((spentPaise * daysInMonth) / dayOfMonth) in whole Long paise and accept explicit date/time inputs for deterministic testing.
6. Defined superseding UNDO bar state replacement so a newer UNDO action replaces the visible bar while leaving the older action in its committed state.
